translation_batches_policy.batch_size_target: 40–60 conversations with source-preserving translation; no inferred quotes

translation_batches_policy.specialist_guard: Do not author personal memories of Archbishop Lefebvre; attributed sources stay distinct from Chanoine's editorial voice
translation_batches_policy.acceptance: Never mark FR parity approved on completion alone; native French specialist must verify accuracy and exact original source claims.
